name: app-banking-research-insight-cards
title: Banking research insights as floating stat cards
whatItIs: A pale slide with a two-tone headline where 'Banking Experience.' is set in bold italic serif. Three white rounded cards at staggered positions carry a question, a big thin percentage and a hatched progress bar or weekday bar.
whatItMeans: Clear, analytical and refined; stagger and whitespace keep the data light.
techniques: Set one phrase of a headline in italic serif for emphasis within a sans title.
Show stats as huge thin numerals with tiny labels.
Fill progress bars with fine diagonal hatching instead of solid colour.
Stagger cards diagonally down the page to create a reading path.

vocabulary.definition: A pattern of thin diagonal lines used as a fill.
A card with a question and one key figure.
Elements offset diagonally instead of aligned.
An italic serif phrase inside sans text.
